release.content: pubdeploy 0.2.0 was released on 2026-11-09 from commit 122bdde7185d01af0ee75ec3951d2cba4aadde81 with these changes.

rows: The checks of pubdeploy's code that were left in pubkit's suite: providers.bump, a type no installed package offers, the trigger rewrite, pubsec's types without pubsec, the provider contract and the walk hook
k8s-deploy.yml calls pubdeploy's own deploy-ssh, at v0.1.0's commit, in place of pubkit's; the suite runs the action's test.sh; two docstrings say pubdeploy where they said pubkit
